import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from collections import OrderedDict
AA3={'ALA':'A','ARG':'R','ASN':'N','ASP':'D','CYS':'C','GLN':'Q','GLU':'E','GLY':'G','HIS':'H','ILE':'I','LEU':'L','LYS':'K','MET':'M','PHE':'F','PRO':'P','SER':'S','THR':'T','TRP':'W','TYR':'Y','VAL':'V','MSE':'M','OCS':'C'}
def get_pdb(p): return requests.get(f"https://files.rcsb.org/download/{p}.pdb",timeout=120).text
def parse(txt,chain):
    res=OrderedDict()
    for l in txt.split("\n"):
        if l.startswith("ENDMDL"): break
        if l[:6]=="ATOM  " and l[16] in (' ','A') and l[21]==chain:
            el=(l[76:78].strip() or l[12:16].strip()[0]).upper()
            if el=='H': continue
            k=(int(l[22:26]),l[26])
            res.setdefault(k,{'name':l[17:20].strip(),'atoms':{}})['atoms'][l[12:16].strip()]=np.array([float(l[30:38]),float(l[38:46]),float(l[46:54])])
    return res
def seq_ca(res):
    ks=[k for k in res if 'CA' in res[k]['atoms'] and res[k]['name'] in AA3]
    return ks,np.array([res[k]['atoms']['CA'] for k in ks])
def kabsch(P,Q):
    Pm,Qm=P.mean(0),Q.mean(0);H=(P-Pm).T@(Q-Qm);U,S,Vt=np.linalg.svd(H)
    R=Vt.T@np.diag([1,1,np.sign(np.linalg.det(Vt.T@U.T))])@U.T;return R,Qm-R@Pm
def art(X,R,t): return (R@np.atleast_2d(X).T).T+t
def dp(S,gap=-0.6):
    n,m=S.shape;F=np.zeros((n+1,m+1));P=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8)
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        Fi=F[i];Fp=F[i-1];Si=S[i-1];Pi=P[i]
        for j in range(1,m+1):
            a=Fp[j-1]+Si[j-1];b=Fp[j]+gap;c=Fi[j-1]+gap
            if a>=b and a>=c: Fi[j]=a;Pi[j]=0
            elif b>=c: Fi[j]=b;Pi[j]=1
            else: Fi[j]=c;Pi[j]=2
    i,j=n,m;pr=[]
    while i>0 and j>0:
        p=P[i][j]
        if p==0: pr.append((i-1,j-1));i-=1;j-=1
        elif p==1: i-=1
        else: j-=1
    return pr[::-1]
def tmalign(ca1,ca2,frag=10,stride=5,nref=15,keep=8):
    L1,L2=len(ca1),len(ca2);d0=max(1.24*(min(L1,L2)-15)**(1/3)-1.8,0.5);seeds=[]
    for i in range(0,L1-frag+1,stride):
        for j in range(0,L2-frag+1,stride):
            R,t=kabsch(ca1[i:i+frag],ca2[j:j+frag])
            D=np.linalg.norm(art(ca1,R,t)[:,None,:]-ca2[None,:,:],axis=2)
            seeds.append((float(np.sum(1/(1+(D.min(1)/d0)**2))),i,j))
    seeds.sort(reverse=True);best=(-1,None,None)
    for sc,i,j in seeds[:keep]:
        R,t=kabsch(ca1[i:i+frag],ca2[j:j+frag])
        for _ in range(nref):
            D=np.linalg.norm(art(ca1,R,t)[:,None,:]-ca2[None,:,:],axis=2)
            pr=dp(1/(1+(D/d0)**2))
            if len(pr)<4: break
            R,t=kabsch(np.array([ca1[a] for a,b in pr]),np.array([ca2[b] for a,b in pr]))
        D=np.linalg.norm(art(ca1,R,t)[:,None,:]-ca2[None,:,:],axis=2)
        pr=dp(1/(1+(D/d0)**2));tm=float(sum(1/(1+(D[a,b]/d0)**2) for a,b in pr)/L1)
        if tm>best[0]: best=(tm,(R,t),pr)
    tm,(R,t),pr=best
    D=np.linalg.norm(art(ca1,R,t)[:,None,:]-ca2[None,:,:],axis=2)
    return tm,R,t,pr,D

G=parse(get_pdb("3Q2U"),"A"); gk,gca=seq_ca(G)
Y=parse(get_pdb("5ETE"),"A"); yk,yca=seq_ca(Y)
tm,R,t,pr,D=tmalign(gca,yca)
m={yk[j][0]:(gk[i][0],float(D[i,j])) for i,j in pr}
print("VALIDATION: Pry1 CAP tetrad (His208, Glu215, Glu233, His250; PMID 27344972) -> GLIPR1")
for rn in [208,215,233,250]:
    k=[kk for kk in Y if kk[0]==rn][0]
    g,d=m.get(rn,(None,None))
    gn=AA3.get(G[[kk for kk in G if kk[0]==g][0]]['name'],'X') if g else '-'
    print(f"  Pry1 {AA3.get(Y[k]['name'],'X')}{rn}  ->  GLIPR1 {gn}{g}  (CA {d:.2f} A)")
print(f"  [GLIPR1 vs Pry1 CAP domain TM-score = {tm:.3f}]")

# ---------------- summary figure ----------------
cons=pd.DataFrame([
 ('CAP tetrad','H79',99.3),('CAP tetrad','E98',100.0),('CAP tetrad','E120',100.0),('CAP tetrad','H137',100.0),
 ('CBM-equivalent loop','Y124',100.0),('CBM-equivalent loop','D125',71.6),('CBM-equivalent loop','F126',69.5),
 ('CBM-equivalent loop','K127',26.2),('CBM-equivalent loop','T128',85.8),('CBM-equivalent loop','R129',41.8),
 ('CBM-equivalent loop','I130',6.4),('CBM-equivalent loop','C131',99.3),
 ('FA-channel equivalent','C37',96.5),('FA-channel equivalent','I40',35.5),('FA-channel equivalent','H41',98.6),
 ('FA-channel equivalent','K43',60.3),('FA-channel equivalent','F44',73.0),('FA-channel equivalent','E47',49.6),
 ('FA-channel equivalent','N99',100.0),('FA-channel equivalent','W101',100.0),('FA-channel equivalent','V110',79.4),
 ('FA-channel equivalent','A113',97.2),('FA-channel equivalent','I114',75.2),('FA-channel equivalent','W117',98.6),
 ('FA-channel equivalent','Y118',73.8),('FA-channel equivalent','V141',85.1),('FA-channel equivalent','F171',96.5),
 ('FA-channel equivalent','C173',97.9),('FA-channel equivalent','Y175',97.9)],
 columns=['group','residue','pct_identical'])
pock=pd.DataFrame([('GLIPR1\n(3Q2U)',422,0.39,112,0.38),('tablysin-15\n(3U3N)',437,0.27,166,0.70),
                   ('Pry1 CAP\n(5ETE)',369,0.37,75,0.54),('GAPR-1\n(1SMB)',224,0.29,104,0.24)],
                  columns=['prot','v1','h1','v2','h2'])

fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,3,figsize=(17,5.2))
ax=axes[0]
cols={'CAP tetrad':'#2b7a4b','CBM-equivalent loop':'#b3452c','FA-channel equivalent':'#3a5f8f'}
x=np.arange(len(cons))
ax.bar(x,cons.pct_identical,color=[cols[g] for g in cons.group])
ax.set_xticks(x); ax.set_xticklabels(cons.residue,rotation=90,fontsize=8)
ax.axhline(90,ls='--',c='grey',lw=1)
ax.set_ylabel('% identical across 141 vertebrate GLIPR1 orthologs')
ax.set_title('Conservation of mapped CAP positions in GLIPR1',fontsize=11)
for g,c in cols.items(): ax.bar(0,0,color=c,label=g)
ax.legend(fontsize=8,loc='lower left')

ax=axes[1]
w=0.35; xx=np.arange(len(pock))
ax.bar(xx-w/2,pock.v1,w,color='#9ab3cc',label='largest buried cavity')
ax.bar(xx+w/2,pock.v2,w,color='#c98b5e',label='2nd cavity')
for i,r in pock.iterrows():
    ax.text(i-w/2,r.v1+8,f"{r.h1:.2f}",ha='center',fontsize=8)
    ax.text(i+w/2,r.v2+8,f"{r.h2:.2f}",ha='center',fontsize=8)
ax.set_xticks(xx); ax.set_xticklabels(pock.prot,fontsize=9)
ax.set_ylabel('cavity volume (cubic angstrom)')
ax.set_title('Buried cavities (numbers = hydrophobic fraction of lining)',fontsize=11)
ax.legend(fontsize=8)
ax.annotate('palmitate site',xy=(1.18,166),xytext=(1.6,300),fontsize=9,
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->',color='k'))

ax=axes[2]
clash=pd.DataFrame([('H41',2.67),('F44',0.41),('E47',1.50),('I114 backbone',2.15),('T115',2.76),('W117',3.10)],
                   columns=['residue','min_dist'])
ax.barh(clash.residue,clash.min_dist,color='#b3452c')
ax.axvline(3.2,ls='--',c='k',lw=1)
ax.text(3.3,0.2,'acceptable\ncontact',fontsize=8)
ax.set_xlabel('minimum distance to transplanted palmitate (angstrom)')
ax.set_title('Tablysin-15 palmitate placed in the GLIPR1 frame\n(TM-score 0.77, 158 core residues, RMSD 2.0 A)',fontsize=11)
ax.invert_yaxis()
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
